wire_ops.value: List issues, optionally filtered by status or assignee and capped with limit. Use to browse or filter issues by those fields; use search_issues when you have a text query, and get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Comments are included only when include_comments is true.

Search issues using a text query. Use when you have keywords or a query to find issues; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Comments are included only when include_comments is true.

Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Use when you already know the issue ID; use list_issues or search_issues to find issues otherwise. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.
